I don't believe you will find a tool that migrates filters for Seamonkey or Thunderbird.

So I would say you want to install Thunderbird version 60 and point it to a copy of your Seamonkey profile.

From there, you want to be careful about updating Thunderbird - https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/upgrading-older-version-thunderbird

Let us know how it goes.
